name: systematic-debugging
tagline_zh: 遇到 bug 别急着改代码，先按流程定位根因。从复现到验证，每一步都有清单，避免修了又坏。
tagline_en: Stop guessing, start tracing. A step-by-step debug workflow that finds root causes and prevents repeat fixes.
desc_en: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
why_zh: 它把调试变成可重复的流程，强制你先复现再动手，比凭直觉乱试更稳。
why_en: Turns debugging into a repeatable protocol—forces reproduction before action, beating intuition-driven trial and error.
